snippet.title: Why Reading the Bible Feels Hard and How to Approach It
snippet.description:
In this clip from the Jubilee Church Podcast, Jordan Dillon and Pastor Bryan Mowrey address the common struggle many Christians face when reading Scripture.
Bryan and Jordan explore why Bible reading can sometimes feel confusing or overwhelming, how to approach Scripture without guilt, and why the challenge is part of its beauty.

📺 Watch the full conversation here: https://youtu.be/hP4FG_Z3I3w
